issue.body:
### What happened?

```mlir
  func.func private @cudnn.pointwise_relu(
    %input: !my.type, %lower: f64, %upper: f64
  ) -> !my.type
```

gets converted to 

```mlir
  func.func private @cudnn.pointwise_relu(
    %input: !my.type, %lower: f32, %upper: f32
  ) -> !my.type
```

and then fails calling convention validation at model loading time.

All type conversion passes should take extra care of imported functions, however if imported function has `tensor<f64>` argument, presumably it has to be demoted to `tensor<f32>` together with every other tensor in the program?
issue.title: DemoteF64ToF32Pass corrupts signature of imported functions

This patch will disable bit-width changes for modules that have external functions. Since the body of the function is compiled elsewhere and just linked, any modification will cause linker issues.

Fixes: #12987

Fixes #12987.
